subject: Request: temporary schedule change due to caregiver relocation
messages:
From: Emily Rodriguez <emily@acme-biotech.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary schedule change due to caregiver relocation

Hi Neha and Lauren,

I wanted to flag a time-sensitive family situation and ask for short-term schedule flexibility. My partner needs to relocate cross-state for a work commitment and I will be primary caregiver for two weeks during the move (Nov 23–Dec 6). I can still meet key deadlines but will need a daily shift adjustment: start at 11:00am PST and end 7:00pm PST instead of my usual 9–5 for that two-week window, with one fully remote day on Fridays to handle deliveries and appointments.

I've attached a relocation notice and a short note from the pediatric clinic confirming appointments. I'm happy to coordinate handoffs and pair with someone for on-call coverage during overlap times. Please let me know what information you need from my side to log this as an accommodation.

Thanks for understanding — I want to avoid surprises for the team.

Best,
Emily Rodriguez
Senior Account Executive, Acme Biotech
(emergency contact available upon request)

Attachments: relocation_notice.pdf (pdf), doctor_note.pdf (pdf)
From: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
To: Emily Rodriguez <emily@acme-biotech.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary schedule change due to caregiver relocation

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the docs. I appreciate the proposed schedule and the two-week window you outlined. We'll need to do two things quickly:

1) Confirm operational coverage with Lauren so customer SLAs remain covered during the shifted hours.
2) Route an accommodation request to HR so this is documented (we'll need the clinic note and the relocation notice).

Lauren — can you confirm whether the proposed 11–7 shift + remote Friday is feasible for the team between Nov 23–Dec 6 and whether Marcus should be looped for coverage planning? If we have quick sign-off we can escalate to HR Benefits and get the formal accommodation filed.

Emily, I will start the HR form and will send you a DocuSign link to sign the accommodation acknowledgement once Lauren confirms coverage.

- Neha
Neha Kapoor
People Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Thanks for the details, Emily — and thanks Neha for triaging.

Operationally this looks workable. Marcus, can you confirm whether the following coverage plan will work? I drafted a short shift handoff plan and marked the key SLAs:
- Emily maintains core call window 11:30–12:30 PST for east-coast accounts (we'll shift some east-coast-facing calls to later in the day).
- Marcus or an assigned backup to pick up first-thing AM urgent tickets 9:00–11:00 (30m triage, then pass to Emily).
- Fridays remote OK; we will avoid scheduled demos on Fridays for the two-week window.

I've uploaded a quick coverage worksheet — shift_coverage_plan.xlsx — with suggested pairings and a proposed calendar of handoffs. Marcus, if you can confirm by EOD tomorrow we can proceed to HR.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: shift_coverage_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Hi Lauren, Neha —

Thanks, Lauren — the coverage plan looks good to me. I can be flexible on the 11:30–12:30 core call window if it helps. The only hard constraint is the Friday remote day to receive movers and handle the pediatric appointment on Nov 27.

One add: I may need to swap one of my scheduled internal planning calls to Dec 7 — I'll flag that directly to the owner.

Emily
